verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe an agent skill that lets AI agents run scripts against Anytype data to perform bulk edits, transformations, and repetitive tasks, backed by a local API and headless CLI for automation (anytype-docs-5, anytype-docs-37, anytype-docs-2, anytype-docs-1). However, this is a developer/agent-script pathway rather than a built-in bulk-edit UI, and a community user explicitly notes the lack of a native 'merge/bulk update' feature when re-importing large datasets, suggesting native bulk operations are still limited. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of built-in multi-select/bulk-edit UI, independent hands-on verification of bulk scripting at scale, and resolution of the community-reported gap around bulk merge/import operations.
